input.quote: Such audit shall not occur more than [***] in a given Calendar Year, unless for cause, and shall not concern books and records relating to a period more than [***] preceding the current Calendar Year.
input.rationale: Section 9.9 is the only provision giving RevMed audit rights over Sanofi's payment records (the Article VI audit right at p0354 runs in our favour, against RevMed, so is not flagged). It is mutual and contains every material element of the preferred position: capped frequency (no more than [***] per Calendar Year), advance written notice, access only via an independent auditor of international prominence that must be reasonably acceptable to us and must sign a confidentiality agreement (9.9(d)), a report limited to describing non-compliance and the discrepancy amount with no disclosure of our other Confidential Information (9.9(b)), a look-back window tied to the retention period in 9.8, and cost borne by the auditing Party unless an underpayment exceeds a stated percentage threshold (9.9(c)). There is no right of direct or remote access to Customer systems and no unannounced or unlimited audit right, so walk-away territory is not engaged. The specific numerals for notice, frequency and the underpayment percentage are redacted ([***]), so we cannot confirm whether they hit the preferred 30 days/5% or sit at the fallback 15 days/10%; these figures should be confirmed against the unredacted execution copy. The "unless for cause" carve-out to the frequency cap is a minor sub-element short of the preferred wording and, given the clause is fully reciprocal, does not warrant a redline.
